manifest.matching_method: Road rows group by zone+PAP+region+chainage-stripped title base; everything else groups by zone+PAP+region+place shell (work phrase + municipality + province, dropping barangay/sitio/street — the split axis). Attached pairs collapse to one HGAB-anchored record (NEP amount + delta as provenance). Two finding states: hgab_leftover (NEP supply fully paired, House rows remain — split / insertion candidates, with a scale pattern: split_like 0.2–5× median ratio, unsupplied_cluster paired item far larger, micro_supplied reverse) and nep_leftover (House side fully paired, NEP supply remains — dropped or re-titled candidates). Neither is a certified insertion or deletion.

summary.flag_description: House-only row on a same-shell group (road corridor, or work + municipality + province place shell) whose NEP rows are all attached to other House rows; similar projects exhausted with no remaining NEP match. Split / insertion or scope-expansion candidate — group context provided, identity never certified.
